title: Who Shouted From This Ghost Ship? #shorts
description: North Carolina, January 1921: a red-haired man shouted from the schooner Carroll A. Deering that she had lost her anchors. Two days later she was found on Diamond Shoals, every sail set, and no one aboard. The crew was never found. Full true story on the channel. #shorts #ghostship #outerbanks #1921 #truestory #hollowmere

beats.en: 1921. A man on a ship shouts: we lost our anchors!
beats.es: 1921. Un hombre en un barco grita: ¡perdimos las anclas!
beats.de: 1921. Ein Mann auf einem Schiff ruft: Anker verloren!
beats.fr: 1921. Un homme crie d'un bateau : on a perdu nos ancres !
beats.it: 1921. Un uomo su una nave grida: perse le ancore!
beats.pt: 1921. Um homem num navio grita: perdemos as âncoras!

beats.en: Two days later, the ship is found. Every sail up. No one aboard.
beats.es: Dos días después hallan el barco. Velas izadas. Nadie a bordo.
beats.de: Zwei Tage später: das Schiff. Alle Segel gesetzt. Niemand an Bord.
beats.fr: Deux jours après, on trouve le bateau. Voiles hautes. Personne.
beats.it: Due giorni dopo, la nave. Vele issate. Nessuno a bordo.
beats.pt: Dois dias depois, o navio. Velas içadas. Ninguém a bordo.

beats.en: The crew was never found. And the red-haired man?
beats.es: La tripulación nunca apareció. ¿Y el pelirrojo?
beats.de: Die Mannschaft blieb verschwunden. Und der Rothaarige?
beats.fr: L'équipage ne fut jamais retrouvé. Et l'homme roux ?
beats.it: L'equipaggio mai ritrovato. E l'uomo dai capelli rossi?
beats.pt: A tripulação nunca apareceu. E o ruivo?

beats.en: So if a ship waves at you tonight...
beats.es: Así que si un barco te saluda esta noche...
beats.de: Wenn dir heute Nacht ein Schiff zuwinkt...
beats.fr: Alors si un bateau te fait signe ce soir...
beats.it: Quindi se stanotte una nave ti saluta...
beats.pt: Então, se um navio acenar pra você esta noite...
